mapper.select: SELECT rs.reservation_id, rs.reservation_no, rs.patient_id, p.name AS patient_name, e.dept_id AS department_id, d.dept_name AS department_name, rs.doctor_id, e.name AS doctor_name, rs.reserved_at, rs.status, rs.note, NVL(rs.is_active, 1) AS is_active, rs.inactive_at, rs.inactive_reason_code, rs.inactive_reason_text, rs.canceled_at, rs.cancel_reason_code, rs.cancel_reason_text, rs.created_by, rs.updated_by, rs.created_at, rs.updated_at FROM RESERVATION rs LEFT JOIN patient p ON p.patient_id = rs.patient_id LEFT JOIN jch.employee e ON e.doctor_id = rs.doctor_id LEFT JOIN jch.department d ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id WHERE rs.reservation_id = #{reservationId}
